Below are proposed commands and dispatches, not execution claims. Keep `WAVE_BASE_SHA` fixed at `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`, even after the worker commits.

### 1. Stage and capture the initial CR tree

Run in a persistent shell:

```bash
cd /workspace/project || exit 1
WAVE_BASE_SHA=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
REVIEW_RECORDS=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1

capture_review_tree() (
  FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
  FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
  cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
  GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
  FD_STATUS=$?
  rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
  exit "$FD_STATUS"
)

git add -A || exit 1
capture_review_tree > "$REVIEW_RECORDS/wave1-cr1.tree" || exit 1
cat "$REVIEW_RECORDS/wave1-cr1.tree"
```

Stop review dispatch on any capture error. The initial review source includes both staged deliverables, including the new test:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project diff --stat "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" -- .
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" -- .
```

No previous-report marker belongs on this first review.

```ts

  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",

Task Description:
[insert available full Task 1 verbatim]

TEST_CONTRACT:
[insert available Tests block and Create:/Test: paths verbatim]

Behaviour-change: yes

Address the report, self-review, and report test-contract evidence.
Return explicitly DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED.
```

Do not instruct this worker to commit or stage.

The supplied observation is that it returns `DONE` and has nevertheless committed at `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. Preserve that work; do not change the review base.

The parent’s scoped gate is:

```bash

```

```bash

capture_review_tree > "$REVIEW_RECORDS/task1-sr2.tree" || exit 1

git -C /workspace/project diff --binary \
  "$(cat "$REVIEW_RECORDS/wave1-cr1.tree")" \
  "$(cat "$REVIEW_RECORDS/task1-sr2.tree")" \

cat "$REVIEW_RECORDS/repair.delta"
```

### 4. CR re-review, then fold

Before CR, stage and capture again:

```bash

capture_review_tree > "$REVIEW_RECORDS/wave1-cr2.tree" || exit 1
git -C /workspace/project diff --binary \
  "$(cat "$REVIEW_RECORDS/wave1-cr1.tree")" \
  "$(cat "$REVIEW_RECORDS/wave1-cr2.tree")" \
  > "$REVIEW_RECORDS/cr2.delta" || exit 1
```

Dispatch `code-reviewer` foreground at `/workspace/project`, retaining the initial payload’s requirements, scoped command, `BASE_SHA`, and `HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE`. Append:

```text
Verdict: FIX_FIRST
Moderate: src/parse.mjs accepts an empty string as zero; reject it and add coverage in tests/error.test.mjs.
Behaviour-change: yes

## Fix delta
[insert cr2.delta verbatim]
```

Also append the supplied code-quality template’s **complete re-review trajectory block verbatim**. Review the whole integrated wave, not merely the delta.

Only after the supplied `SHIP` observation:

```bash
git -C /workspace/project reset --soft \
  1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 &&
git -C /workspace/project add -A &&
git -C /workspace/project commit -m "Fix numeric parsing and cover empty input"
```

Stop on failure or an empty commit. After successful durable commit, update the existing Task 1 tracker entry to `complete`; do not reinitialize it.

**Empty repair delta:** dispatch no re-review. Count a failed attempt, resend the prior report with “your fix changed no tracked file,” and apply the existing two-attempt limit. A new commit SHA alone does not establish a repair.
